PRE-ORDER MY BOOK: https://vinhgiang.com/before-we-forget-how-to-connect

In this video I want to share with you three powerful lessons that I took away from the book "How to Win Friends and Influence People" by Dale Carnegie, who I consider the godfather of communication. 

I hope you find these lessons as useful as I did on your journey to becoming a better communicator. 

And if you've been following me for a while and you want to dive deeper into your ability to communicate more influentially Then make sure you pre-order a copy of my new book before we forget how to connect. If you order it now, you'll get a special pre-order bonus where you'll get a free live ticket to my virtual event in August called "Break the Mould", where I'll help you apply the skills that will transform your ability to communicate. 

PRE-ORDER MY BOOK: https://vinhgiang.com/before-we-forget-how-to-connect

=== About Vinh Giang ===
Vinh Giang is an internationally acclaimed keynote speaker, communication skills expert, and magician. He blends his unique talents to captivate audiences and deliver powerful lessons on the art of influence, persuasion, and effective communication. His mission is to empower individuals and leaders to communicate with clarity, confidence, and impact, enabling them to unlock new levels of success in both their personal and professional lives.
